summary.short_summary: Quanta is focusing on acquiring US and UK marketing technology firms to build scalable platforms, planning for an IPO in India within 18 to 24 months. Gaming Audience, led by CEO Ameer Hashish, has achieved $2.9 million in revenue with an 85% gross margin through a data-as-a-service platform that provides audience data without requiring PII. The company is exploring strategic partnerships to enhance growth and streamline operations. Their innovative bidding model captures high-value users, and there is significant untapped market potential in mobile app publishers. Both companies see synergies in expanding internationally, particularly in India and Southeast Asia, leveraging Quanta's financial backing and regional connections.
